rationale: Roberts is best positioned to craft the narrow, institutionally cautious majority that treats delay as relevant to identifying true Espinosa-level voidness but not as an independent bar once voidness is shown. The dissent is most likely led by Alito or Kagan emphasizing Rule 60(c)(1)’s categorical text and Kemp, with possible separate concurrences from Thomas or Gorsuch to stress the traditional meaning of “void” and constitutional limits on adjudicative authority.
